offline_banner: You are offline. You see the last data loaded; changes wait for a connection.
noaccess_text: You are signed in as {name}, but you are not a member of any app. Ask an owner to add you, then reload.
signin_text: The team signs in with the Psizone account, the same across every app.
signin_unavailable: Sign-in is not configured on this server.
calendar_empty_text: There are no appointments in this period. Press “New appointment” to add one.
error_title: We could not load the data
error_text: The scheduling service is not answering. Your data is safe; try again.
toast_invalid: Fill in every field of the appointment.
clients_empty_text: No clients match. Change the filter or the search.
archive_confirm_text: {name} leaves the active list, but appointments, packages and records stay. You can always find them in the Archive.
delete_confirm_text: This deletes {name}, their appointments and packages. It cannot be undone. To only hide them, use Archive.
invite_card_text: The client sees their appointments and can switch on notifications on their phone.
invite_existing: The address already had an online account: it was linked to the client.
invite_revoke_text: The link in the e-mail stops working and the account no longer shows the client's appointments. The account itself is not deleted.
invite_pick_label: Who do we send the invitation to?
invite_pick_client: The client, at their own address
invite_preview_note: This is how the e-mail will look. The real link is made when it is sent.
invite_preview_existing: The address already has an online account: the e-mail links it to the client without setting a password.
invite_err_no_email: The chosen contact has no e-mail address.
invite_err_already_invited: An invitation is already waiting. Send it again if needed.
invite_err_already_active: The client already has an active account.
invite_err_account_disabled: This address's account is switched off in the sign-in system.
invite_err_client_not_active: Only an active client can be invited.
invite_err_too_soon: The invitation was sent a moment ago. Try again in a minute.
invite_err_contact_changed: The address changed since the invitation. Withdraw it and send a new one.
invite_err_revoked: The invitation was withdrawn: send a new one.
invite_err_forbidden: You may not use this contact.
invite_err_unavailable: Sign-in is not answering right now. Nothing was sent.
invite_err_other: We could not send the invitation. Nothing changed.
records_empty_text: Session reports and questionnaires appear here, for those allowed to see them.
files_empty_text: The client’s documents are kept here, encrypted.
roster_empty_text: Add people in Settings to see them here.
requests_empty_text: Requests from the site appear here, with the requester’s phone.
toast_request_done: The request was marked as handled.
reminders_empty_text: There are no active appointments on this day.
reminder_hint: One tap opens WhatsApp with the message ready; there is no second confirmation in the app.
reminder_text: Hello! A reminder of the appointment for {name}: {date} at {time}, {place}. Please confirm you are coming. Thank you!
settings_empty_text: Add the first entry from the scheduling service.
roles_saved: The role was saved; it applies at once.
roles_hint: Each permission is resource × action × scope. Changes apply at once and are written to the audit log.
notif_sending_later: Sending notifications starts in a later step; your choice is kept.
audit_empty_text: Every change appears here: who, what and when.
pkg_ring_label: {left} of {total} sessions left, {bonus} of them bonus
pay_invalid: Enter an amount above zero, for example 350 or 1,350.50.
pkg_timeline_none: No session is linked to this package yet.
pkg_invalid_value: That value cannot be read. Nothing changed.
pkg_too_few: A package cannot hold fewer sessions than are already used.
pkg_new_invalid: The package was not created: fill in the name, the sessions and the price.
dev_signin_text: Pick a person from the local service; the console treats them as a real account.
dev_signin_unreachable: The scheduling service does not answer.
view_as_role_empty: Pick a person with this role to see their data: a role on its own has no clients of its own.
view_as_lead: See the app as a role or a team member sees it. It is view-only: while it is on, nothing can be changed.
view_as_banner: Viewing the app as {name} — view only
view_as_readonly: While you view the app as someone else nothing can be changed. Exit the view to work.
forbidden_title: You do not have access here
forbidden_text: Your role does not include this part of the app. If you need it, ask an administrator.
soon_text: This part is not available in the scheduling service yet. It appears here as soon as it is ready.
rate_text: Try again in a few seconds.
conflict_text: Someone else already made a change that clashes with this one. Reload and try again.
role_gist_admin: Everything but roles, the journal and the owner's own powers; manages every member except administrators and owners.
role_gist_owner: The organisation's highest role: everything the administrator can do, plus roles, the journal and the administrators.
role_gist_coordinator: Runs the team and the calendar: appointments, clients, the roster and leave.
role_gist_reception: The calendar, clients (contact, guardian, money), packages, payments and reminders; no clinical data.
role_gist_therapist: Their own appointments and clients, with their clinical data, reports and records.
role_gist_accountant: The money: prices, packages, payments and the financial reports; no clinical data.
role_gist_volunteer: What they were given to help with: the calendar and the activities they assist.
floor_empty_title: The floor plan is not drawn yet
floor_empty_text: Draw the rooms in Settings and you will see here, live, which room is free and which is busy.
